title: Hands-on: one booking app, three AI builders
population: Lovable, Replit and Emergent, each on its free plan with a new account, given the same prompt word for word.
selection: Three AI app builders from our catalogue that build a working app with a database from a prompt.

headline.text: first versions let ten simultaneous bookings into an eight-spot class (check T05)

metrics.label: checks per builder, written down before the first build

limitations: One run per builder on one day.
The builders' affiliate relationships are listed in results.json (Lovable's started after the test).
The full measurement log contains admin passwords of the test apps and is not published.
next_full_recheck: re-test after a relevant product change; repeat runs are planned as a protocol series
